summary: Jefferies Financial Group Inc. filed a 424B5 preliminary pricing supplement for a $1,000-per-note offering of senior autocallable barrier notes due July 31, 2031, linked to the worst-performing of three indices. The notes are unsecured, part of its Series A medium-term note program, and include an autocall feature with a ~12.50% per annum call premium and barrier protection at maturity. This filing is a routine structured note takedown under an existing shelf registration, not a special-situations event. No deal terms table is applicable beyond the note terms; the offering is a standard capital markets transaction.
